_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy this file to manifest.json to record provenance for the Dragos WorldView data you have placed under this directory. The loader works without a manifest (it auto-discovers report bundles under reports/), but a manifest lets you record which WorldView perspective the export was scoped to and when it was pulled. manifest.json is git-ignored and will never be committed.
license_attestation: I attest that my organization holds a valid Dragos WorldView subscription and that this data is used only for local, private evaluation. It is not redistributed.
_notes: Report bundles: drop each product's files into reports/. A bundle is grouped by its serial prefix (e.g. AIR-2026-14) and may contain a narrative PDF, a *.stix2.json bundle, and a *-IOCs-*.csv. PDF-only products are fine. Future WorldView exports (Vulnerabilities, Threat Groups) can be added under vulnerabilities/ and threat_groups/ subdirectories.
